maya: quick heads-up  I opened PR #4720 to refresh the local dev quickstart: canonical env var, tiny Node + Python snippets, GitHub Actions CI example, and a one-liner Docker run. Please skim for anything that will break workshop material.

ian: what env var did you standardize on? we have a bunch across slides.

maya: REDWOOD_API_KEY only. added a short migration note for teams still using LEGACY_TOKEN and a mapping snippet for CI.

noah: can you paste the Node and GH Actions snippets here so I can check shapes and process cleanup?

maya: Node snippet from PR:```
// quickstart/index.js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
(async () => {
  const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hello' });
  console.log(res.output.text);
  await client.close();
})();
```
GitHub Actions (CI) example:```
name: quickstart-ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set REDWOOD_API_KEY
        run: echo "REDWOOD_API_KEY=${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - run: node index.js
```

soph: small asks: 1) change any `res.text` to `res.output.text` (we standardised), 2) call out Node >= 18 and Python >= 3.11 in prereqs, 3) add a Windows PowerShell note for setting env vars.

maya: added prereqs and a PowerShell example for Windows: `setx REDWOOD_API_KEY "<key>"` and a note about ESM/CJS pitfalls.

noah: paste the Python snippet too?

maya: Python snippet from PR:```
# quickstart/app.py
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt='hello')
print(resp.output.text)
client.close()
```

noah: looks good. add `if resp.error: ...` in a comment to encourage handling. Also for CI add a minimal Docker run: `docker build -t qs . && docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY qs`. Call out M1 mac users may need platform flags.

maya: added error-handling comment and Docker one-liner plus a parenthetical about `--platform=linux/amd64` for some macs. Removed streaming from the main quickstart and put it in an "advanced: streaming" appendix.

soph: I found two broken links in the private deploy and KMS anchors; pasted corrected URLs in the PR comment. Also suggest a tiny troubleshooting box: 401 -> check REDWOOD_API_KEY + org allowlist; 429 -> check usage dashboard.

docs-bot: PR #4720 labeled docs/quickstart and assigned to maya. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/4720

maya: thanks all  will push the tiny edits now and merge after a quick thumbs. If anyone wants to demo the Docker run in tomorrow's onboarding lab, ping me here. :shipit:
